#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline SIP identity boundary processor (identity boundary protocol, revision 1).

Reads one JSON batch object on stdin, writes one JSON object with per-job results
on stdout.  All parsing is strict per PROTOCOL.md; syntax failures precede
authentication and identity failures.
"""

import json
import sys

ANONYMOUS = "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"
MAX_TEXT = 32768
MAX_PHYS = 512
MAX_LOGICAL = 128
MAX_CSEQ = 2147483647

_D = "0123456789"
TOKSET = frozenset(_L + _D + "-.!%*_+`'~")
USERSET = frozenset(_L + _D + "-_.!~*'()+")
ALNUMSET = frozenset(_L + _D)
DIGITSET = frozenset(_D)
HEXSET = frozenset(_D + "abcdefABCDEF")
CALLIDSET = frozenset(_L + _D + "_.@+-")
OK_HEAD = frozenset(chr(c) for c in range(0x20, 0x7F)) | frozenset("\t")
OK_BODY = OK_HEAD | frozenset("\r\n")
WSCH = " \t"

COMPACT = {"f": "from", "t": "to", "i": "call-id", "l": "content-length",
           "c": "content-type"}
REQUIRED = ("from", "to", "call-id", "cseq", "content-length")
SINGLETON = frozenset(("p-preferred-identity", "remote-party-id", "privacy",
                       "content-type"))


class Reject(Exception):
    def __init__(self, reason):
        Exception.__init__(self)
        self.reason = reason


def bad():
    raise Reject("syntax")


def denied():
    raise Reject("identity")

def build_wire(req, selected, private, trusted_out):
    lines = [req["method"] + " " + req["ruri"] + " SIP/2.0"]
    line = "From: <" + (ANONYMOUS if private else selected) + ">"
    if req["from_tag"] is not None:
        line += ";tag=" + req["from_tag"]
    lines.append(line)
    line = "To: <" + req["to_uri"] + ">"
    if req["to_tag"] is not None:
        line += ";tag=" + req["to_tag"]
    lines.append(line)
    lines.append("Call-ID: " + req["call_id"])
    lines.append("CSeq: " + str(req["cseq"]) + " " + req["method"])
    lines.append("Privacy: " + ("id" if private else "none"))
    if (not private) or trusted_out:
        lines.append("P-Asserted-Identity: <" + selected + ">")
    if req["content_type"] is not None:
        lines.append("Content-Type: " + req["content_type"])
    lines.append("Content-Length: " + str(len(req["body"])))
    return "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n\r\n" + req["body"]


def forwarded(job, index, results):
    if "raw" in job:
        text = job.get("raw")
        if not isinstance(text, str):
            bad()
        return text
    if "source" in job:
        src = job.get("source")
        if (not isinstance(src, int) or isinstance(src, bool) or src < 0
                or src >= index or src >= len(results)):
            raise Reject("upstream")
        previous = results[src]
        if previous.get("status") != "accept":
            raise Reject("upstream")
        text = previous.get("wire")
        if not isinstance(text, str):
            raise Reject("upstream")
        return text
    bad()                                          # no request text supplied


UNKNOWN = "\x00unknown-context"


def key(value):
    """Keep lookups total even for unexpected context types."""
    return value if isinstance(value, str) else UNKNOWN


def handle(job, index, results, ctx):
    if not isinstance(job, dict):
        bad()
    text = forwarded(job, index, results)
    req = parse_request(text)                      # grammar first, always
    gw_name = key(job.get("gateway"))
    ingress = job.get("ingress")
    kind = ingress.get("kind") if isinstance(ingress, dict) else None
    private = req["from_uri"] == ANONYMOUS or req["privacy_id"]
    if kind == "local":
        selected, basis = select_local(req, key(ingress.get("subject")), gw_name, ctx)
    elif kind == "peer":
        selected, basis = select_peer(req, key(ingress.get("name")), gw_name, ctx)
    else:
        raise Reject("unauthenticated")             # no evidence at all
    wire = build_wire(req, selected, private, bool(job.get("trusted_out")))
    return {"status": "accept", "identity": selected, "basis": basis,
            "private": bool(private), "wire": wire}
